_comment: Which scenarios feed which EJIT quadrant, and what an answer is worth. The
single source for both: the game imports this file to build its radar axes
and to score its options, and the Modal aggregation reads the same file to
average scores per quadrant, so the two cannot drift.
points: what each alignment scores, per card. A non-aligned answer costs as
much as a fully aligned one earns, so zero is the middle of the range rather
than its floor -- which is why the radar puts zero on its middle ring.
Scenario 17 appears in two quadrants on purpose and card 20 is deliberately
in none, so the four lists hold 20 slots over 19 cards. Each slot is worth
